exposure: Circulating tumor cells (CTCs) in maternal and umbilical cord blood
outcome: Absence of cancer cells in placenta or umbilical cord
cohort: A 30-year-old woman diagnosed with stage IVC appendiceal cancer during pregnancy and her infant.
finding: Maternal circulating tumor cells (CTCs) were detected in both maternal and umbilical cord blood samples, coinciding with the infant developing neonatal purpura and disseminated intravascular coagulation, despite no direct cancer cells found in the placenta or umbilical cord.
mod_finding: The infant was delivered via Cesarean section at 30 weeks 1 day gestational age.
